## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; CI is green
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, docs/, `.env.example`, docs/metrics.md) where behaviour or settings change
- [ ] New files carry the SPDX header
- [ ] Contract change (device protocol, registry or rules, schema, `/v1`, events, settings, metrics): agreed in an issue and marked **contract** in CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] New dependency: licence compatible with Apache-2.0, listed in THIRD_PARTY.md
